headline: 'Now Really Giving Up on Stocks?' After Selling 18 Trillion Won in September Alone… Buying of US ETFs Also Halved [Investment 360]
summary: Individual investors net sold 17.9231 trillion won on the KOSPI through the 22nd, a switch to monthly net selling for the first time since April. Buying of US ETFs also reportedly halved.
why: Retail investor flows are a gauge of domestic demand for local equities and can influence short-term market liquidity.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Heavy individual selling on the exchange is a flow factor for the index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Individual investors were net sellers of KOSPI stocks, switching to monthly net selling for the first time in five months.
